text:
lina.dev: Heads-up: security triage — found a chain affecting grpc (google.golang.org/grpc) and the jwt/oauth library used in rdw-token-service. Repro indicates a header parsing OOB that can lead to mis-signed tokens. I plan to file a CVE but we need a fast mitigation. Thoughts on pinning + KMS key rotation + audit hooks for Private deployments?

mike.sec: @lina.dev please add the CVE ID once filed. Immediate steps: blocklist vulnerable versions in the dependency scanner and open a hotfix branch. For KMS: even if library is patched, we should rotate signing keys used in affected services.

raj.eng: Quick inventory: rdw-token-service imports grpc v1.x and github.com/golang-jwt/jwt. Local test shows grpc v1.55.0 includes a parsing fix; jwt needs v4.5.0. net/http changes not required unless we vendor custom Transport.

raj.eng: Proposed go.mod snippet to pin:
```
require (
  google.golang.org/grpc v1.55.0
  github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v4.5.0
)
replace github.com/golang-jwt/jwt => github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v4.5.0
```

ashley.sre: For Dedicated/Private customers we need an emergency rollout playbook:
- create hotfix image tag `hotfix/security/<timestamp>`
- enforce restart window (non-rolling) for small fleets or canary then sweep for large ones
- invalidate token caches (KV + in-memory) on restart
Backport plan: branch `release-1.3.x` -> cherry-pick PRs.

carla.pm: Customer impact question: which accounts run rdw-token-service on Dedicated/Private? Need list so Support + AMs can prepare comms and customer-specific rotation guidance.

deploy-bot: CI started: prs/2145 (hotfix/go-dep-pin). Tests: unit ok, integration auth-e2e failing: token expiry mismatch in harness.

raj.eng: failing test is due to KV cache retaining old signing keys. I'll add cache invalidation and ensure hotfix triggers key refresh. Also adding a `tools/dep-check` run in CI to block unpinned transitive updates.

mike.sec: Audit logging requirement: add structured audit events for key rotations and for any token issuance where the signing library version < patched. Set retention for those events to 90 days for incident evidence. @auditbot can you provision the policy?

auditbot: Acknowledged. Creating policy `security-emergency-2026` with retention=90d and notify=security@redwood.com. Will attach policy to Private control planes and Dedicated fleet logging.

lina.dev: Action items (target ship in 24h, monitor 72h):
1) raj.eng: PR with pinned versions + cache invalidation + CI dep-check (owner: raj)
2) mike.sec: draft customer disclosure + KMS rotation play + incident timeline (owner: mike)
3) ashley.sre: rollout playbook + backport branches (owner: ashley)
4) carla.pm: customer list + comms templates (owner: carla)

raj.eng: I'll own the PR and push tests.

mike.sec: I'll own disclosure and rotation docs.

ashley.sre: I'll author the playbook and start a canary tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

carla.pm: I'll pull customer list and prepare tailored notices.

lina.dev: Thanks all — I'm creating tracking ticket SEC-2026-88 and will update with CVE when filed. If anything blocks the 24h ship call it out here.

mike.sec: noting dependency scanner rule to immediately block pre-patch versions across org.

raj.eng: pushing PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/rdw-token-service/pull/2145

deploy-bot: PR merged -> main@hotfix/security/2003123456. Build and deploy started to canary.

ashley.sre: Canary reports healthy so far. Monitoring auth-slo & error-rate dashboards.

lina.dev: Closing notes: post-mortem if disclosure needed; capture timeline + test vectors. Good job team.
